title: A location with no time zone counts due dates on UTC
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure customer A holds Net 30.
  • Make sure the work order belongs to the test location, which has no time zone set.
  • Make sure work order 1 for customer A is complete and ready to invoice (every part received, review done).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1's Finance tab.
  2. Set Invoice Date to Oct 20, 2026.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The invoice preview shows Invoice Date and Due date.

Step 2:

  • The Due date reads Nov 19, 2026 (Oct 20 + 30 days, counted on the UTC calendar, which has no clock change).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
